% Original PageCue fixture: separate controls, posters, and two pages.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[paperwidth=170mm,paperheight=100mm,margin=8mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{animate}
\pagestyle{empty}
\newcommand{\frameboxcolor}[2]{\colorbox{#1}{\rule{0pt}{20mm}\makebox[50mm]{#2}}}
\begin{document}
\noindent Two independent animations\par\bigskip
\begin{minipage}{72mm}
Manual, last-frame poster\par
\begin{animateinline}[controls,poster=last]{4}
\frameboxcolor{red}{One}
\newframe
\frameboxcolor{green}{Two}
\newframe
\frameboxcolor{blue}{\color{white}Three}
\end{animateinline}
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}{72mm}
Autoplay and loop\par
\begin{animateinline}[controls,autoplay,loop]{7}
\frameboxcolor{yellow}{A}
\newframe
\frameboxcolor{magenta}{B}
\end{animateinline}
\end{minipage}
\newpage
No poster before playback\par\bigskip
\begin{animateinline}[controls,poster=none]{3}
\frameboxcolor{cyan}{First}
\newframe
\frameboxcolor{yellow}{Second}
\end{animateinline}
\end{document}
